name: Streaming Answer
description: A monochrome answer card: reads its sources, streams words that settle like ink, links numbered citations to sources, with Stop, Regenerate and Copy.

props.name: question
props.description: The question, set as the semibold headline.

props.name: answer
props.description: Paragraphs. **bold** for emphasis; [n] for a citation pointing at sources[n − 1].

props.name: sources
props.type: { title: string; publisher: string; href: string }[]
props.description: Numbered sources listed after the answer finishes.

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Stream once in view. When false the finished answer shows until Regenerate is pressed.

props.name: pace
props.description: Multiplies every delay; 0.5 streams twice as fast.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the citation being pointed at and its source.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette. Both are greyscale apart from the accent.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root article.

controls.label: Question
controls.default: Why does my sourdough collapse when it goes in the oven?
